name: Rosewood Bermuda
positioning: Coastal resort in Hamilton Parish, Bermuda, above the shores of Castle Harbour, with a private pink-sand beach club and the Tucker's Point golf course
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach, water sports and golf in one place
Families, with a dedicated pool and a kids club

facts.text: Rosewood Bermuda is in Hamilton Parish and sits above the shores of Castle Harbour.
The property was built in 2009 and reopened in 2018 after Rosewood Hotels acquired it.
The building has a traditional British-colonial look.
Ocean View King Rooms have a private balcony with views of Castle Harbour.
Poolside Cabana King Rooms have a terrace leading to a private poolside alcove with a daybed.
Island Brasserie is a modern steakhouse serving global cuts and fresh local seafood.
Mirador is a waterfront spot for Patron cocktails, coastal bites and ocean views.
Sul Verde serves Italian lunch and dinner menus by Chef Maximo Villagra.
Tucker's Bar offers rum tastings and Bermuda classics like the Rum Swizzle.
Tucker's Point Golf Club is set on 200 acres of hills overlooking the sea.
Water sports range from stand-up paddleboards to sea kayaks and sailing.
There is a dedicated pool and a kids club for children.

highlights.text: Island Brasserie displays an 80-foot run of canvas murals commissioned in 1965 by Pan Am founder Juan Trippe for the Sky Club in Manhattan's Pan Am Building.
Guests get access to Bermuda's largest private pink-sand beach.
Gombey dancer performances, guided tours of forts and churches, and artist-in-residence programs share the island's African, European and Caribbean heritage.
On the Coral Garden Tour guests snorkel or paddle over living reefs with marine experts and learn about local reef restoration.
The Beach Club Restaurant serves fresh seafood, sushi and seasonal barbecue.

considerations.text: The Beach Club is seasonal, a few minutes from the Manor House.
Hamilton is about a 20-minute taxi ride away.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing and that the island location requires flight connections.

sources.title: Rosewood Bermuda review - Condé Nast Traveler
